title: Stieltjes-generated moment functionals and orthogonality: a transfer principle and an image theorem
summary: We study the orthogonality induced by Stieltjes derivatives from the point of view of ordinary polynomial moment functionals. If \(g\) is a derivator and the Stieltjes monomials \(g_{x_0,n}\) are linearly independent, the map \(Φ(t^n)=g_{x_0,n}\) is an isomorphism of differential algebras onto the ordinary polynomial algebra, and the intrinsic \(\star\)-bilinear form on \(g\)-polynomials is the pull-back of a single ordinary moment functional \(\mathcal L\). The object of interest is therefore not a new polynomial algebra but the functional generated by the derivator, and our main theorem…
